about.title: About Me
about.description: A passionate software developer with a strong focus on delivering high-quality applications. Experienced in building innovative solutions that enhance user experience and business efficiency. Adept at working in dynamic environments, collaborating with teams, and continuously learning to improve and adapt to new challenges. Specialized in Flutter development and eCommerce applications with expertise in mobile and web platforms.

experience.title: Software Developer

projects.title: Border Ports App
projects.description_short: An app for authorized personnel to monitor and manage operations at border ports efficiently.
projects.description_long: The Border Ports app is a specialized platform designed for authorized personnel to monitor and manage operations at border ports. It provides real-time insights into port activities, including cargo tracking, revenue monitoring, and operational status across multiple border locations. Key features include centralized data access, customizable dashboards for different roles, and secure reporting tools to ensure smooth and efficient port management.

projects.title: Benz Technical App
projects.description_short: Flutter-based eCommerce app for electricians and users to browse, buy electrical products, and earn rewards.
projects.description_long: The Benz Technical App (also known as Ataa-Electrician App) is a Flutter-based eCommerce solution for electricians and end-users. It offers a seamless platform to explore vendor catalogs, purchase products from nearby dealers, and benefit from a rewards system. Features include search and filter options, a streamlined shopping cart, secure checkout, and unique gifting options (search, order with points, track orders), creating an enhanced and rewarding shopping experience.

projects.title: Nasr Election App
projects.description_short: An app that simplifies registration and tracking of voter data at polling stations for election agents.
projects.description_long: The Nasr app makes it easier for election agents to register and track voter data at their polling stations. The app supports adding new voters with their full details and allows for editing or deleting information when necessary. It features a basic function for determining each voter's voting status (voted/did not vote) via a quick and straightforward option. Its simple interface is suitable for field work and ensures immediate, seamless data updates, making it an ideal tool for monitoring electoral processes accurately and quickly.

projects.title: Darbak – Customer Application
projects.description_short: A multi-service transportation app allowing users to request rides, deliveries, and towing services.
projects.description_long: Darbak is a Flutter-based transportation and on-demand services application that enables users to request taxi rides, goods delivery, and towing services through a single platform. The app focuses on simplicity, fast booking, real-time tracking, and seamless communication between customers and drivers, providing a reliable urban mobility experience.

projects.title: Darbak Captain – Driver Application
projects.description_short: A driver-focused app enabling captains to accept rides, manage trips, and track earnings in real time.
projects.description_long: Darbak Captain is the driver-side Flutter application designed for Darbak service providers. Captains can receive and accept ride requests, navigate to pickup and drop-off locations using live maps, manage trip history, and monitor earnings. The app is optimized for performance, real-time updates, and ease of use for drivers operating on the Darbak platform.

projects.title: Fashion – Modular eCommerce Application
projects.description_short: A flexible modular eCommerce platform for web and mobile that streamlines online store creation and deployment.
projects.description_long: Fashion represents a cutting-edge modular eCommerce platform designed for both web and mobile environments, engineered to revolutionize the process of creating and deploying online stores. The platform features a flexible, component-based architecture that enables rapid customization and deployment of eCommerce applications tailored to diverse business requirements. With its modular design approach, Fashion allows businesses to quickly adapt their online presence, scale their operations efficiently, and customize their digital storefronts without extensive development overhead. The platform serves as a comprehensive foundation for building robust eCommerce solutions that can evolve with changing business needs. My contribution focused on developing the mobile section of the platform, ensuring the application framework is highly adaptable and easily customizable for building mobile eCommerce applications quickly and efficiently.

projects.title: EpiHope – Epilepsy Patients Health Tracking Application
projects.description_short: Comprehensive healthcare application for epilepsy patients and doctors with health tracking, medication management, and research access.
projects.description_long: EpiHope is a sophisticated healthcare management application specifically designed to support epilepsy patients and medical professionals in effectively managing health information and medication regimens. The platform features two specialized portals: the Doctor's Portal provides healthcare professionals with access to the latest medication research articles and cutting-edge epilepsy-related studies, keeping them informed about treatment advances; the Patient's Portal empowers patients with access to the same research materials while offering comprehensive tools for tracking health episodes, monitoring symptoms, and managing medication schedules with automated reminder systems. The project encompasses an advanced Admin Dashboard built with Next.js, providing administrators with powerful content management capabilities to maintain and update the platform's extensive medical resources. My contribution involved collaborating on the admin dashboard development, creating comprehensive article management functionality including creation, deletion, editing, and publishing features, while also developing the complete patient-side features in the Flutter application, focusing on health episode tracking, medication management, and reminder systems to enhance patient care and treatment adherence.

projects.title: Green – Multivendor Farming Application
projects.description_short: A dual-role multivendor app for farmers and hobbyists to buy farming tools, seeds, and equipment with tailored content for each user type.
projects.description_long: Green is a Flutter-based multivendor eCommerce platform designed for the agricultural sector, catering to both farmers and hobbyists. The app provides two distinct user experiences: Farmers can browse vendors and products relevant to professional agriculture, such as seeds, farming equipment, and specialized tools; Hobbyists can explore vendors and products more suited to small-scale or home farming projects. Both user types can add products to their cart, proceed to checkout, and view their order history. The platform ensures personalized content visibility, allowing each user type to see products and offers that are most relevant to their needs, creating a more engaging and efficient shopping experience in the farming industry.

projects.title: Lamasat – Furniture eCommerce Application
projects.description_short: A furniture eCommerce platform with dual account types for regular users and designers, offering browsing, purchasing, and custom request features.
projects.description_long: Lamasat is a Flutter-based eCommerce application dedicated to housing and interior furniture. It offers two account types: Regular Users, who can explore furniture collections, view product details, add items to their cart, proceed to checkout, and track orders; and Designers, who have all the same capabilities as regular users, plus the ability to request specific custom products by attaching reference images and descriptions. This dual-role system enables both standard consumers and professional designers to shop and collaborate more effectively, creating a flexible marketplace for furnishing needs.

projects.title: Multivendor Restaurants Modular Application
projects.description_short: A modular multivendor platform for restaurants with menu browsing, ordering, and vendor management features.
projects.description_long: This Flutter-based multivendor restaurant application offers a fully modular architecture that supports multiple restaurants under one platform. Users can browse restaurant menus, filter by cuisine type, place orders, and track deliveries in real time. Vendors can manage their menus, receive orders, and update their availability. The modular design allows for easy integration of additional features like loyalty programs, promotional campaigns, and delivery tracking. It is built for scalability, ensuring it can grow from small local food markets to large multi-city operations.
